verdict.rationale: SumUp ships SDKs, apps and a managed MCP server, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has no documentation of any telemetry controls, analytics opt-out, or usage-tracking settings. The axis applies, but nothing shows the product delivers it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
